feedback.question: Show me the company name and total Assets for all 10-K filings from the 2023 fiscal year.
feedback.sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.value FROM submissions AS T1 INNER JOIN numbers AS T2 ON T1.adsh = T2.adsh WHERE T1.form = '10-K' AND T1.fy = 2023 AND T2.tag = 'us-gaap:Assets';
feedback.comment: should have been Assets insted of us-gaap:Assets

feedback.question: how many companies are incorperated in califronia
feedback.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cik) FROM submissions AS T1 WHERE T1.stprinc = 'CA';
